parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::text AS service_id, $2::timestamptz AS win_s,
         $3::timestamptz AS win_e, $4::text AS exclude_stylist_id
),
free AS (
  SELECT st.id, st.name, st.title, st.rating
  FROM p
  JOIN stylist_service ss ON ss.service_id = p.service_id
  JOIN stylist st         ON st.id = ss.stylist_id AND st.active
  JOIN business_hours bh  ON bh.stylist_id = st.id
       AND bh.weekday = EXTRACT(DOW FROM (p.win_s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date)::smallint
       AND p.win_s >= (((p.win_s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date + bh.opens_at)  AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')
       AND p.win_e <= (((p.win_s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')::date + bh.closes_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila')
  WHERE (p.exclude_stylist_id IS NULL OR st.id <> p.exclude_stylist_id)
    AND p.win_e > p.win_s
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM appointment a
                    WHERE a.stylist_id = st.id AND a.status = 'confirmed'
                      AND tstzrange(a.starts_at, a.ends_at) && tstzrange(p.win_s, p.win_e))
)
SELECT json_build_object(
  'service_ok',   EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM service s, p WHERE s.id = p.service_id AND s.active),
  'window_ok',    COALESCE((SELECT win_e > win_s FROM p), false),
  'window', (SELECT json_build_object(
                'starts_at_utc',   to_char(win_s AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'ends_at_utc',     to_char(win_e AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"'),
                'starts_at_local', to_char(win_s AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila','YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'),
                'ends_at_local',   to_char(win_e AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Manila','HH24:MI')) FROM p),
  'alternatives', COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
                     'stylist_id', f.id, 'stylist_name', f.name,
                     'title', f.title, 'rating', f.rating)
                   ORDER BY f.rating DESC NULLS LAST, f.name, f.id) FROM free f), '[]'::json)
) AS result;

parameters.content:
## 23 · find stylist alternatives

**In** `{service_id, starts_at, ends_at, exclude_stylist_id?}`
**Out** `{ok:true, data:{window, alternatives[]}}`

Only stylists who perform the service, whose hours cover the whole window, with nothing confirmed overlapping it. Ranked by rating then name then id — the final id key makes repeated calls byte-identical.

An empty `alternatives` is `ok:true`: "nobody else is free" is an answer, not a failure.

`reason`: `invalid_input` · `invalid_timestamp` · `invalid_window` · `service_not_found` · `db_unavailable` · `timeout`
